primary.title: SEBI reveals ₹3,811 crore unclaimed in mutual funds in FY26; all FAQs answered on how you can check and recover it
primary.summary: SEBI’s Annual Report shows ₹3,811 crore remained unclaimed in mutual funds in FY26, including redemption amounts and dividends. Investors can trace forgotten dues, check whether they have any unclaimed money, and follow a simple process to recover it. Find out how below.
